title: Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient

claim.summary: TradeGrad samples archived strategy programs, has an LLM estimate textual gradients from their backtests and a periodically distilled optimization memory, applies structural rewrites or diff-based edits, and scores candidates with a lower-tail cross-period robust objective.

modules.name: Experience-guided multi-scale textual-gradient revision
modules.scope_reason: Rank-biased archive sampling, periodically distilled success and failure memory, textual-gradient estimation and full-rewrite versus diff-edit revision operate on any scored program and carry no temporal semantics.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "As optimization proceeds, evaluated strategies"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "When ηk = ηlarge"

modules.name: Cross-period lower-tail robust objective
modules.scope_reason: Calendar-year window scores combine annualized return, maximum drawdown and a trading-frequency gate, tying the window-wise lower-tail aggregation to a trading-strategy output.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO) promotes"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "By emphasizing lower-tail performance"
